descripcion: Museum and exhibition room, cinema, theatre and concert hall, library, music venue and nightclub, bowling alley and arcade, and community centre.

vitrina_mesa.descripcion: Table with a glass lid at waist height. Your hand rests on the cold glass; the legs are underneath.
vitrina_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Table display case”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Vm”.

vitrina_vertical.descripcion: Glass column on all four sides, taller than a person. Smooth and cold; walk all the way round it.
vitrina_vertical.imagen: Footprint of “Tall glass display case”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Vv”.

vitrina_mural_volada.descripcion: Glass box hung on the wall at chest height. The cane passes underneath: your shoulder or hand finds it first.
vitrina_mural_volada.imagen: Footprint of “Cantilevered wall display case”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Vm”.

peana_escultura.descripcion: Smooth block up to waist height with a sculpture on top. Push the plinth and the piece may shift: walk round without touching.
peana_escultura.imagen: Footprint of “Plinth with sculpture”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

peana_urna.descripcion: Round wooden stand topped by a glass dome protecting a small piece. Wood below, glass above.
peana_urna.imagen: Footprint of “Plinth with glass dome”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pu”.

tarima_obras.descripcion: Platform a hand's width high on which large pieces stand. The cane touches it low down: a trip hazard if unexpected.
tarima_obras.imagen: Footprint of “Low display platform”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

escultura_exenta.descripcion: Irregular metal sculpture with arms sticking out at different heights. The cane finds the base, but a projection may be at face level.
escultura_exenta.imagen: Footprint of “Large freestanding sculpture”: an irregular outline with projections, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ee”.

esqueleto_montado.descripcion: Skeleton of a large animal on a low platform. Tail and neck overhang the platform at head height: the cane finds the platform, not the bones.
esqueleto_montado.imagen: Footprint of “Mounted skeleton on a platform”: an elongated outline: thin tail on one side, wide body in the middle and neck on the other, 4.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

movil_colgante.descripcion: Light pieces hanging from the ceiling, slowly turning in the air at head height. The cane cannot find it.
movil_colgante.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging mobile”: a circle, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Mc”.

instalacion_suelo.descripcion: Artwork spread over the floor: stones, sand or small objects. No barrier, and it must not be stepped on: walk round it.
instalacion_suelo.aviso: Artwork on the floor: do not step on it, walk round.
instalacion_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Floor installation”: a rounded, irregular patch, 2.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Is”.

maqueta_mesa.descripcion: Large table with a scale model under a clear plastic cover. Walk round all four sides.
maqueta_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Scale model on a table”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mm”.

cuadro_barrera.descripcion: Large painting on the wall with a low rail in front at shin height marking the distance. The cane touches it; the hand does not.
cuadro_barrera.imagen: Footprint of “Large painting with low barrier”: a low rail in front with two thin sides reaching the wall, 2.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

cordon_bajo.descripcion: Thin elastic cord stretched between small posts at shin height. It gives when touched and is hard to detect: the cane may pass over it.
cordon_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low rope barrier”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

catenaria_terciopelo.descripcion: Two metal posts on round bases joined by a thick velvet rope hanging in a curve. Between posts the cane may pass under the rope.
catenaria_terciopelo.imagen: Footprint of “Velvet rope stanchions”: two posts joined by a rope, 1.50 by 0.32 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

cortina_sala_oscura.descripcion: Thick, heavy curtain closing the entrance to a projection room. Push it aside to go through; behind it there is darkness and sound.
cortina_sala_oscura.imagen: Footprint of “Blackout curtain”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

panel_expositor.descripcion: Tall, thin board standing on two cross feet. The feet stick out on each side: the cane touches them before the panel.
panel_expositor.imagen: Footprint of “Freestanding display panel”: a thin panel with a cross foot at each end, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

panel_zigzag.descripcion: Several tall panels joined in a zigzag, like a folding screen. Trailing it by hand, the surface goes in and out in points.
panel_zigzag.imagen: Footprint of “Zigzag display screen”: a zigzag band, like a folding screen, 3.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pz”.

atril_informativo.descripcion: Sloping plate on a stand at waist height carrying the room text, sometimes in braille. The plate overhangs the stand at the front.
atril_informativo.imagen: Footprint of “Sloping information lectern”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ai”.

totem_interactivo_museo.descripcion: Flat column with a touch screen at chest height. It answers with a beep when touched.
totem_interactivo_museo.imagen: Footprint of “Museum interactive kiosk”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ti”.

proyector_tripode.descripcion: Projector on a tripod with three spread legs and a cable on the floor. When on, a fan blows. Catch a leg and it falls.
proyector_tripode.imagen: Footprint of “Projector on a tripod”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

maqueta_tactil.descripcion: Bronze model made to be touched: the building or the piece in miniature, with relief and braille on the rim. It is at hand height.
maqueta_tactil.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile model”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

estacion_tactil_audio.descripcion: Lectern with a relief reproduction to touch and a large button: press it and a voice describes the work.
estacion_tactil_audio.imagen: Footprint of “Touch station with audio”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Et”.

punto_audioguias.descripcion: Unit with pigeonholes where audio guides charge. Take one, hang it round your neck and it speaks when you key in a number.
punto_audioguias.imagen: Footprint of “Audio guide collection point”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

cargador_signoguias.descripcion: Tray hung on the wall one metre up holding sign guides, small screens with sign-language videos. The cane passes underneath.
cargador_signoguias.imagen: Footprint of “Wall rack of sign-language guides”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cs”.

banco_museo.descripcion: Wide padded bench with no back or arms in the middle of the room. Sit down from either side.
banco_museo.imagen: Footprint of “Museum gallery bench”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.80 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

banco_circular_museo.descripcion: Round upholstered seat with a cone-shaped backrest in the middle. You sit facing outwards.
banco_circular_museo.imagen: Footprint of “Round bench with central backrest”: a circle, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

carro_asientos_plegables.descripcion: Wheeled trolley hung with light folding stools for visitors. Take one and carry it through the rooms.
carro_asientos_plegables.imagen: Footprint of “Trolley of folding stools”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

mostrador_entradas_museo.descripcion: Long desk at the entrance, high for standing service, with a lower stretch at 80 centimetres at one end.
mostrador_entradas_museo.imagen: Footprint of “Museum ticket desk”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

consigna_museo.descripcion: Block of small metal lockers for leaving your bag, rucksack and umbrella before going in. Each door locks with a key.
consigna_museo.imagen: Footprint of “Museum bag lockers”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

arco_detector_museo.descripcion: Plastic frame you walk through one at a time, between two columns. It beeps if you carry metal. Go through slowly, in the middle.
arco_detector_museo.aviso: Detector arch: walk slowly through the middle.
arco_detector_museo.imagen: Footprint of “Entrance metal detector arch”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ad”.

mesa_tienda_museo.descripcion: Wide table in the middle of the shop covered in stacked books, prints and souvenirs. The piles may fall if you brush the edge.
mesa_tienda_museo.imagen: Footprint of “Museum shop island table”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.40 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

taquilla_cine.descripcion: Closed booth with a glass window and a slot for passing money and tickets. You speak through a microphone.
taquilla_cine.imagen: Footprint of “Cinema box office”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.80 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

mostrador_palomitas.descripcion: Counter with the popcorn machine on top: you hear the corn popping and smell it from afar. The machine's glass is hot.
mostrador_palomitas.imagen: Footprint of “Popcorn counter”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

cartelera_luminosa.descripcion: Flat box holding the film poster, hung on the wall from the waist up. It sticks out a hand's width and the cane gives no warning.
cartelera_luminosa.imagen: Footprint of “Wall poster light box”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.12 metres, hanging 0.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cl”.

figura_carton_estreno.descripcion: Large cardboard figure advertising a film, standing in the middle of the foyer. Light: it tips over when bumped and moves every week.
figura_carton_estreno.imagen: Footprint of “Cardboard film standee”: a sheet at the back with a narrower foot towards the front, 1.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Fc”.

atril_control_entradas.descripcion: Post with a reader where the usher checks your ticket before you go through to the screens. It beeps on reading.
atril_control_entradas.imagen: Footprint of “Ticket check stand”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

contenedor_gafas_3d.descripcion: Tall plastic bin at the screen exit with a wide opening on top for returning the glasses.
contenedor_gafas_3d.imagen: Footprint of “3D glasses return bin”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

fila_butacas_cine.descripcion: Soft seats joined in a row with arms and cup holders, all facing the screen. You shuffle in sideways between the rows.
fila_butacas_cine.imagen: Footprint of “Row of cinema seats”: a rectangle, 3.40 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Fb”.

butaca_cine_suelta.descripcion: A single cinema seat, wide and soft, with arms. The seat is tipped up and drops when you sit.
butaca_cine_suelta.imagen: Footprint of “Single cinema seat”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

espacio_silla_ruedas.descripcion: Level gap among the seats, marked on the floor, for a wheelchair. There is no seat: it is an empty space in the row.
espacio_silla_ruedas.imagen: Footprint of “Wheelchair space”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

escalon_iluminado.descripcion: Wide, shallow step in the auditorium aisle, carpeted, with a rubber strip on the edge. There is one for each row.
escalon_iluminado.imagen: Footprint of “Lit aisle step”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ei”.

alzadores_apilados.descripcion: Stack of hard plastic cushions by the screen door so children can see. Take one; the stack wobbles.
alzadores_apilados.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked booster seats”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

pantalla_cine.descripcion: Huge screen filling the end wall, raised a metre off the floor. The film sound comes from behind it: it shows which way the seats face.
pantalla_cine.imagen: Footprint of “Cinema screen”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pc”.

proyector_cabina.descripcion: Large machine on a pedestal in the booth, aimed at the auditorium through a small window. When running it clatters and blows hot air.
proyector_cabina.imagen: Footprint of “Cinema booth projector”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

altavoz_envolvente.descripcion: Speaker box bolted to the side wall above head height, tilted towards the seats. It sticks out a long hand's width.
altavoz_envolvente.imagen: Footprint of “Wall surround speaker”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ae”.

fila_butacas_patio.descripcion: Theatre seats of wood and velvet joined in a row with tip-up seats: the seat is up and you push it down by hand.
fila_butacas_patio.imagen: Footprint of “Row of stalls seats”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Fb”.

palco_teatro.descripcion: Small enclosure with a padded parapet in front, waist high, and a partition on each side. You enter from behind. Beyond the parapet is a drop.
palco_teatro.imagen: Footprint of “Theatre box”: a parapet in front and a partition on each side, open at the back, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

mostrador_guardarropa.descripcion: Wide counter behind which coats hang on rails. Hand over your coat and you get a numbered token.
mostrador_guardarropa.imagen: Footprint of “Cloakroom counter”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mg”.

borde_escenario.descripcion: The edge of the stage: beyond it there is a one-metre drop into the auditorium or the pit. There is no rail.
borde_escenario.aviso: Stage edge: stop, there is a drop.
borde_escenario.imagen: Footprint of “Stage edge”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

foso_orquesta.descripcion: Deep pit between the stage and the front row where the musicians play. Straight on the stage side and curved towards the audience.
foso_orquesta.aviso: Orchestra pit: no way through, there is a deep drop.
foso_orquesta.imagen: Footprint of “Orchestra pit”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 5.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Fo”.

telon_boca.descripcion: Huge, heavy curtain closing off the stage. Closed, it is a soft wall of fabric; open, it gathers at the sides.
telon_boca.imagen: Footprint of “Front curtain”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

pata_bambalinas.descripcion: Tall, narrow black cloth hanging at the side of the stage to mask the wings. Actors enter and exit between one and the next.
pata_bambalinas.imagen: Footprint of “Stage wing curtain”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

concha_apuntador.descripcion: Low wooden hood at the centre of the stage edge, open towards the actors. It is at shin height.
concha_apuntador.imagen: Footprint of “Prompter's box”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 1.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

escalera_escenario.descripcion: Short flight of four or five wooden steps set against the front of the stage. It does not always have a handrail.
escalera_escenario.imagen: Footprint of “Stage access steps”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ee”.

barra_tiros.descripcion: Row of thick ropes running up to the ceiling by the side wall, tied off on an iron rail. They raise and lower the scenery.
barra_tiros.imagen: Footprint of “Rope lock rail”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

baul_gira.descripcion: Reinforced case with metal edges and castors in which sound and lighting gear travels. It turns up backstage and gets moved about.
baul_gira.imagen: Footprint of “Flight case on castors”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bg”.

tarima_director.descripcion: Square one-step platform with a rail behind and a wide music stand in front. The conductor stands on it facing the orchestra.
tarima_director.imagen: Footprint of “Conductor's podium with stand”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Td”.

corro_atriles.nombre: Arc of orchestra chairs and stands
corro_atriles.descripcion: Chairs in an arc, each with a thin metal music stand in front. The stands are light and tip over; the arc opens towards the conductor.
corro_atriles.imagen: Footprint of “Arc of orchestra chairs and stands”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 4.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

arpa.descripcion: Concert harp: a tall wooden triangle with taut strings. Run your fingers across and a cascade of notes sounds.
arpa.imagen: Footprint of “Harp”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.55 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

timbales_orquesta.descripcion: Three or four large copper kettledrums set in an arc round the player. The drumhead is at waist height.
timbales_orquesta.imagen: Footprint of “Orchestral timpani”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 2.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

contrabajo_apoyado.descripcion: Double bass upright on a stand, as tall as a person. The hollow wooden body resonates when brushed; the neck is at face height.
contrabajo_apoyado.imagen: Footprint of “Double bass on its stand”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.70 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

bateria.descripcion: Ring of drums and cymbals on metal legs with a seat behind. The cymbals stick out at chest height and ring at the slightest touch.
bateria.imagen: Footprint of “Drum kit”: a rounded ring of drums and cymbals with the seat at the back, 1.60 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

amplificador_guitarra.descripcion: Heavy box with a cloth grille at the front, on the stage floor. When on, it hums quietly all the time.
amplificador_guitarra.imagen: Footprint of “Guitar amplifier”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ag”.

monitor_cuna.descripcion: Low wedge-shaped speaker on the floor at the stage edge, pointing upwards. Below knee height: an easy thing to trip over.
monitor_cuna.imagen: Footprint of “Stage wedge monitor”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

mesa_mezclas.descripcion: Desk covered in knobs and sliders from which the engineer controls the sound, at the back of the room. Bundles of cables come out behind.
mesa_mezclas.imagen: Footprint of “Mixing desk”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mm”.

tripode_foco.descripcion: Three widely spread legs on the floor and a pole rising to a spotlight. The legs get in the way; the lamp at the top is hot.
tripode_foco.imagen: Footprint of “Lighting stand”: a triangle of three spread legs, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tf”.

pie_microfono.descripcion: Heavy round base with a very thin pole. The cane may sweep past without touching it. A boom arm sticks out at face height.
pie_microfono.imagen: Footprint of “Microphone stand”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

cables_sueltos.descripcion: Unprotected sound cables, some coiled, lying across the stage floor. They tangle round your foot and the cane tip.
cables_sueltos.aviso: Cables on the floor: mind your feet.
cables_sueltos.imagen: Footprint of “Loose cables on the floor”: an irregular trail, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

tocador_camerino.descripcion: Narrow table against the wall with a large mirror ringed with light bulbs. When on, the bulbs burn to the touch.
tocador_camerino.imagen: Footprint of “Dressing room mirror table”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

burro_vestuario.descripcion: Tall wheeled rail with two bars, loaded with long costumes. Soft at the sides; at the bottom only castors and a crossbar.
burro_vestuario.imagen: Footprint of “Theatre costume rail”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

estanteria_doble_cara.descripcion: Freestanding metal shelving with books on both faces. Set in parallel they form narrow aisles; trail your hand along the book spines.
estanteria_doble_cara.imagen: Footprint of “Double-sided library shelving”: a rectangle, 2.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ed”.

armario_compacto.descripcion: Block of shelving units pressed together that travel on rails when you turn a wheel: one aisle opens as another closes. The rails stand proud of the floor.
armario_compacto.imagen: Footprint of “Mobile shelving on rails”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

fichero_fichas.descripcion: Wooden cabinet with many long, narrow little drawers, each with its pull and label. The cards stand in a row inside.
fichero_fichas.imagen: Footprint of “Library card catalogue”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ff”.

planero.descripcion: Wide, deep metal cabinet with very shallow drawers for storing maps and prints flat. It comes up to the waist.
planero.imagen: Footprint of “Map chest”: a rectangle, 1.30 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

taburete_rodante_biblioteca.descripcion: Low, round plastic stool on hidden castors: it rolls when pushed and locks when stood on. It gets left behind in the aisles.
taburete_rodante_biblioteca.imagen: Footprint of “Library kick stool”: a circle, 0.44 by 0.44 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

escalera_rodante_biblioteca.descripcion: Ladder of three or four steps with handrails and castors for reaching the top shelves. Wider at the bottom than at the top.
escalera_rodante_biblioteca.imagen: Footprint of “Rolling library ladder”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.65 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Er”.

mesa_lectura_lamparas.descripcion: Very long table with a row of low lamps down the middle and chairs on both sides. The lamps are warm and have a pull-chain switch.
mesa_lectura_lamparas.imagen: Footprint of “Long reading table with lamps”: a rectangle, 3.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ml”.

puesto_estudio.descripcion: Single desk with panels at the front and sides screening you from your neighbour. Several in a row form a line of booths open at the back.
puesto_estudio.imagen: Footprint of “Study carrel”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

puesto_consulta_catalogo.descripcion: Tall stand with a screen and keyboard for looking up books standing. There is no seat; the keyboard is at elbow height.
puesto_consulta_catalogo.imagen: Footprint of “Catalogue search terminal”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

globo_terraqueo.descripcion: Large sphere on a wooden stand at chest height. It spins when pushed and has the continents in relief.
globo_terraqueo.imagen: Footprint of “Floor-standing globe”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Gt”.

mostrador_prestamo.descripcion: L-shaped desk by the entrance: a high stretch for standing service and a low one, at 80 centimetres, for sitting or wheelchair users.
mostrador_prestamo.imagen: Footprint of “Library issue desk”: an L shape, 3.00 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

buzon_devolucion.descripcion: Metal box with a flap at chest height through which returned books are dropped; they land with a thud.
buzon_devolucion.imagen: Footprint of “Book return box”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bd”.

maquina_autoprestamo.descripcion: Unit with a tray where you place the books and a screen above. It beeps twice when the loan is recorded.
maquina_autoprestamo.imagen: Footprint of “Self-checkout library kiosk”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

expositor_novedades.descripcion: Four-sided stepped unit showing new books face-out near the entrance. Wider at the bottom than at the top.
expositor_novedades.imagen: Footprint of “New titles display”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “En”.

revistero_inclinado.descripcion: Tall unit with sloping shelves on which magazines rest face-out. Each shelf lifts and back issues are stored behind.
revistero_inclinado.imagen: Footprint of “Sloping magazine rack”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ri”.

hemeroteca_barras.descripcion: Frame from which the day's newspapers hang, each clamped in a wooden stick. The paper rustles when brushed.
hemeroteca_barras.imagen: Footprint of “Newspaper stick rack”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Hb”.

asiento_curvo_lectura.descripcion: Long, curved upholstered seat without arms, made of joined modules. Trail your hand along the backrest as it bends round.
asiento_curvo_lectura.imagen: Footprint of “Curved modular reading seat”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 2.40 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

cubeta_cuentos.descripcion: Low wheeled box, open at the top and divided into compartments, where picture books are browsed from above. At small-child height.
cubeta_cuentos.imagen: Footprint of “Children's picture book browser box”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

rincon_cojines.descripcion: Corner with a mat and big cushions piled up for reading lying down. Soft and low: your foot sinks in.
rincon_cojines.imagen: Footprint of “Children's cushion corner”: a quarter circle with its corner at the back left, 2.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rc”.

grada_cuentacuentos.descripcion: Two or three wide padded steps in a half-moon where children sit and listen. You can climb up anywhere along the front.
grada_cuentacuentos.imagen: Footprint of “Storytelling steps”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 2.40 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Gc”.

cabina_dj.descripcion: High desk with the decks and mixer, closed at the front and with a wing on each side. The DJ stands inside. The music comes from here.
cabina_dj.imagen: Footprint of “DJ booth”: a wide desk in front with two wings going back, 2.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

pista_baile.descripcion: Clear area with a smooth wooden floor, different from the rest of the room. No furniture: what moves on it is people.
pista_baile.imagen: Footprint of “Dance floor”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

podio_baile.descripcion: Small, high eight-sided platform for dancing on. It reaches knee or hip height and has no rail.
podio_baile.imagen: Footprint of “Dance podium”: an octagon, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

valla_antiavalancha.descripcion: Solid metal barrier in front of the stage, chest high, with a floor plate on the audience side and a step on the other.
valla_antiavalancha.imagen: Footprint of “Crowd crush barrier”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Va”.

torre_altavoces.descripcion: Large speaker cabinets stacked at one side of the stage. With the music on, the air throbs in front: best not to stand right by it.
torre_altavoces.imagen: Footprint of “Speaker stack”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

bafle_tripode.descripcion: Speaker raised on a tripod: three spread legs and a pole below; above, a box at head height.
bafle_tripode.imagen: Footprint of “Speaker on a tripod”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

torre_luces.descripcion: Lattice column of aluminium tubes carrying the lights, on a base with four arms in a cross spreading over the floor.
torre_luces.imagen: Footprint of “Lighting truss tower”: a cross, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tl”.

bola_espejos.descripcion: Sphere covered in tiny mirrors hanging from the ceiling over the dance floor, turning slowly above head height.
bola_espejos.imagen: Footprint of “Mirror ball”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, hanging 2.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Be”.

pista_bolos.descripcion: Long, narrow lane of oiled wood with a sunken gutter on each side. Very slippery: do not step beyond the foul line.
pista_bolos.imagen: Footprint of “Bowling lane”: a rectangle, 1.70 by 18.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

linea_falta_bolos.descripcion: Line across the floor where the approach ends and the oiled lane begins. You may come this far with the ball.
linea_falta_bolos.aviso: Foul line: go no further, the lane is slippery.
linea_falta_bolos.imagen: Footprint of “Bowling foul line”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Lf”.

retorno_bolas.descripcion: Long, low unit between two lanes: the balls come back under the floor, rise and line up. You hear them rolling and knocking together.
retorno_bolas.imagen: Footprint of “Ball return”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.60 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rb”.

estante_bolas.descripcion: Metal rack of bars holding the house balls sorted by weight. The balls are heavy: if one drops, it rolls far.
estante_bolas.imagen: Footprint of “Bowling ball rack”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

consola_puntuacion.descripcion: Pedestal with a keypad and a small screen at the head of the lane where the players' names are entered.
consola_puntuacion.imagen: Footprint of “Scoring console”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

banco_curvo_bolera.descripcion: Curved bench of hard plastic where players wait their turn. It wraps round a small table and opens towards the lane.
banco_curvo_bolera.imagen: Footprint of “Curved bowling bench”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 2.50 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

mostrador_zapatos_bolera.descripcion: Bowling counter backed by pigeonholes of shoes sorted by size. Here you swap shoes and pay for the game.
mostrador_zapatos_bolera.imagen: Footprint of “Shoe rental counter”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mz”.

maquina_recreativa.descripcion: Tall cabinet with a screen, a joystick and buttons at waist height. Even with no one playing it repeats its little tune.
maquina_recreativa.imagen: Footprint of “Arcade cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

pinball.descripcion: Sloping glass-topped table on four legs with a tall backbox at the far end. A button on each side; in play it clacks and bells ring.
pinball.imagen: Footprint of “Pinball machine”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pi”.

simulador_coche.descripcion: Low seat with a steering wheel and pedals in front of a large screen. Get in from one side and drop into the seat, as in a car.
simulador_coche.imagen: Footprint of “Driving simulator”: a T shape, 1.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

grua_peluches.descripcion: Glass cabinet full of soft toys with a claw hanging inside and a joystick outside. The prize drops into a hatch at the bottom.
grua_peluches.imagen: Footprint of “Claw crane machine”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

canasta_recreativa.descripcion: Long net cage with a hoop at the far end and balls rolling back down a ramp to your hands.
canasta_recreativa.imagen: Footprint of “Arcade basketball hoop”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

maquina_baile.descripcion: One-step metal platform with arrows to stamp on and a bar behind to hold, facing a cabinet with a screen and speakers.
maquina_baile.imagen: Footprint of “Dance machine”: a T shape, 1.80 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

cambio_monedas.descripcion: Metal box on the wall with a slot for notes and a cup below where the coins drop.
cambio_monedas.imagen: Footprint of “Change machine”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

hockey_aire.descripcion: Large table with a high, rounded rim. When running, air blows through the surface with a hum and the puck clacks against the rails.
hockey_aire.imagen: Footprint of “Air hockey table”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.25 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ha”.

mesa_ajedrez.descripcion: Small square table with the board marked in relief on the top and the pieces set up. A seat on each side.
mesa_ajedrez.imagen: Footprint of “Chess table”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

ajedrez_gigante.descripcion: Board painted on the floor with hollow plastic pieces reaching knee or hip height. The pieces are light and moved by hand.
ajedrez_gigante.imagen: Footprint of “Giant floor chess”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ag”.

mesas_plegables_apiladas.descripcion: Folded tables stood on edge in a trolley or against the wall. Long, thin and heavy: if they slip they fall like a slab.
mesas_plegables_apiladas.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked folding tables”: a rectangle, 1.85 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

escenario_modular.descripcion: Two-metre by one-metre decks joined on metal legs, hollow underneath. The edge has no rail and no warning.
escenario_modular.imagen: Footprint of “Modular stage platforms”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

atril_orador.descripcion: Narrow wooden unit, closed at the front up to chest height, with a sloping top and a gooseneck microphone on it.
atril_orador.imagen: Footprint of “Speaker's lectern”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ao”.

pantalla_portatil.descripcion: Wide sheet hanging from a mast on a tripod. Only the legs are at the bottom, in the middle; the sheet starts at waist height.
pantalla_portatil.imagen: Footprint of “Portable tripod projection screen”: a T shape, 1.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

caballete_pintura.descripcion: Three spread wooden legs holding a canvas at chest height. The back leg splays out a long way: easy to catch.
caballete_pintura.imagen: Footprint of “Painting easel”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

torno_alfarero.descripcion: Round wheel head spinning inside a splash pan with a low seat attached. It hums when running; the floor around is wet with clay.
torno_alfarero.imagen: Footprint of “Potter's wheel”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

horno_ceramica.descripcion: Thick eight-sided cylinder clad in sheet metal with the lid on top. When firing it stays hot outside for hours.
horno_ceramica.imagen: Footprint of “Pottery kiln”: an octagon, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Hc”.

telar.descripcion: Large wooden frame with taut threads, treadles below and a bench in front. It creaks and thumps when weaving.
telar.imagen: Footprint of “Floor loom”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

mesa_urna_votacion.descripcion: Long table with a clear box on top that has a slot in the lid. Three people sit behind it; the vote goes in through the slot.
mesa_urna_votacion.imagen: Footprint of “Table with ballot box”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mu”.

expositor_folletos_asociaciones.descripcion: Narrow tower of plastic pockets full of leaflets, on a foot. Light: it takes little to tip it over.
expositor_folletos_asociaciones.imagen: Footprint of “Community leaflet stand”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ef”.

cartel_enrollable.descripcion: Tall, narrow sheet rising from a long base on the floor, held taut by a pole behind. Very light: a draught or a brush knocks it over.
cartel_enrollable.imagen: Footprint of “Roll-up banner”: a rectangle, 0.85 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.
